implemented: New ORB/GAP outcomes from the observed-quote intraday runner are persisted with shadow mode and classify as EXPLORATORY_SHADOW.
The live local-paper lane receives no new ORB/GAP outcomes, preventing them from entering the formal paper-book/champion allocation path.
Existing historical live rows remain unchanged and queryable.
The board, report, and live viewer explain the SHADOW-only boundary and retain evidence-failed status.
